title: Taler Invoice Reference
description: Taler Contract Terms object binding the M0 coin commitment to a B2B invoice payment. Generated by Taler Exchange alongside the DTEPPublicRecord. Transmitted to the buyer outside DRRDB. Not stored in the public level.

summary.description: Human-readable payment summary. Shown in Taler wallet.

order_id.description: Taler order identifier. Set to the M0 coin commitment value for DRR binding.

amount.description: Payment amount in Taler amount format. Matches M5 amount. Format: EUR:XXXXXX.XX

pay_deadline.description: Payment deadline. ISO 8601. Derived from EN 16931 BT-9 payment due date.

fulfillment_url.description: Corner 5 Middleware endpoint for payment confirmation callback.

merchant.description: Seller information in Taler Contract Terms format. Subject identifiers scrubbed per DD-18.

name.description: Seller name. DD-18 scrubbed: SHA512(salt || seller_name). Not human-readable — present for Contract Terms structural compliance.

instance.description: Taler merchant instance identifier for the seller.

address.description: Seller address in Taler format. DD-18 scrubbed.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Retained as-is.

products.description: Invoice line items in Taler Contract Terms format.

description.description: CPV code from M2. Used as product description for DRR binding.

price.description: Line item price in Taler amount format.

quantity.description: Quantity. Derived as M5/R(c,t) where available.

nace_seller.description: NACE code from M3. Extension field for DRR binding.

nace_buyer.description: NACE code from M4. Extension field for DRR binding.

m0_reference.description: Explicit binding between the Taler Contract Terms and the DTEP-F DRR record.

commitment.description: M0 coin commitment. Links this payment to the DTEPPublicRecord.

public_record_id.description: URN UUID of the corresponding DTEPPublicRecord in DRRDB.

exchange.description: Taler Exchange instance URI that generated M0 and this Contract Terms object.

auto_refund.description: Optional auto-refund deadline for advance payment scenarios. If set, Taler Exchange automatically refunds if fulfillment_url does not confirm delivery.

lifecycle_reference.description: M0 commitment of the original invoice for correction or credit note Contract Terms.
